summary: Touch-friendly on-screen keyboard that types into a TMP_InputField.
overview: An on-screen keyboard for a kiosk with no physical keyboard, editing a TMP_InputField's text and caret directly. It drives a grid of KeyButtons you build at author time rather than generating layout at runtime — matching the convention the rest of the UI toolkit follows, so the layout is something you can see and adjust in the scene.
useCases: Entering a name or email on a touch kiosk.
A search field on a public display.
Any build with a touchscreen and no keyboard attached.

params.tuning: Rebindable at runtime through Bind, which is how one keyboard serves a username and a password field.
The KeyButtons of your author-time layout. Build the QWERTY or numeric layout once and reuse it.

gotchas.title: The layout is built by you, not generated
gotchas.body: That is deliberate, and it means adding a key is a scene edit rather than a setting.
